collection.name: DO NOT OPEN
collection.milestonesRule: Who holds which box and how many boxes were sold are encrypted. Only these milestones of the sold count are announced, one by one; the last one is the cap and means sold out.

affection.goldenRule: at reveal, affection > goldenThreshold turns the accessory golden; a cat with no accessory gets a golden bell collar

mint.rule: Draw one 64-bit encrypted seed per box. Derive stateRoll and the five trait rolls from the seed layout, compute state and rarityScore. Only the program may compute on these values: the holder gets NO blanket decryption right, otherwise shake and observe would be pointless.

shake.rule: The program picks one of the five traits with an encrypted uniform draw and grants the holder a private decryption of two fresh values: the picked trait's seed offset and its roll. Never reveals state or rarityScore. Unlimited.

observe.rule: Two steps. Request: the seed becomes publicly decryptable. Finalise: anyone submits the decrypted seed with its proof; the program verifies it, derives state, traits and score in the clear, and stores them. Entangled partner is observed too.

proveAlive.rule: Two steps, once per box. Request: computes the single encrypted bit (state == alive) and makes it publicly decryptable. Finalise: anyone submits the verified bit. If true, grants the Vet Certified badge. Nothing else leaks; the bit is public whichever way it falls.

duel.caller: the holder posts, any holder takes it up
duel.rule: Post, prove, take up, finalise. A holder puts box A on the duel shelf, open to any sealed box or reserved for one; the posting makes the bit (the caller holds A) publicly decryptable, and only a proven posting goes on the shelf, for lifetimeDays. One listing per box. Taking it up with box B makes public: A is still held, both boxes are held, then masked by the latter the bit (scoreA > scoreB), a uniformly picked trait offset, and the loser's roll for that trait. Ties go to B. If A was no longer held the duel is void; if only B was not held, the duel goes back on the shelf. Winner's win counter increments. The loser's picked trait becomes public, never the state.

entangle.rule: Links two unrevealed boxes. A box has at most one partner. Observing one observes the other.

feed.rule: Adds an encrypted uniform amount between perFeedMin and perFeedMax to the encrypted affection counter. Cats are fickle: the number of feeds is public, the affection it earned is not. Sealed boxes only.

paidShake.rule: Same trait pick as shake, but the decryption right goes to the payer only. 70% of the fee goes to the holder.

token.name: Croquettes
token.rule: CROQ is a plain ERC-20 so it can be traded on public markets; cCROQ is its confidential ERC-7984 wrapper at a 1:1 rate and is what the game uses. The whole supply is minted once at deployment; nothing can mint more.

allocation.name: Game reserve
allocation.rule: Wrapped into the Pantry. Pays the daily purr, and takes back 60% of every meal, so it only runs dry if the cats stop eating.

allocation.name: Welcome bags
allocation.rule: Wrapped into the Pantry. One bag per box: maxSupply x welcomeBag.

allocation.name: Market liquidity
allocation.rule: Seeded into a public CROQ/USDC pool.

allocation.name: Treasury
allocation.rule: Kept by the collection owner as plain CROQ, for events and future liquidity.

welcomeBag.rule: Paid once per box, not per wallet, on the box's first claim. A box that changes hands does not get a second bag.

purr.rule: Each claim draws one encrypted amount in 0..maxPerDay per box, multiplies it by the whole days since that box's last claim (at most maxDays), doubles it for Vet Certified boxes and halves it once per halvingDays since the Pantry was deployed. Paid from the game reserve, capped by what is left in it.

meal.rule: Only the holder feeds a sealed cat, an encrypted amount of cCROQ. The cat eats it all: its encrypted weight goes up by the amount. The meal is split: treasuryBps to the collection's treasury, burnBps burnt, the rest (60%) back to the game reserve that pays the purr, so croquettes go round. At most mealsPerDay meals and maxEatenPerDay croquettes per cat and per UTC day, however they are spread: an offer past what is left of the day is cut down to it, silently. A feeder who holds too little moves 0, with no revert and no leak. Nobody can read a weight while the box is sealed. The number of meals is public.

sick.rule: Each cat has a tolerance in [minWeight, minWeight + weightSpread), keccak256 of its seed folded into that range. The seed is encrypted until the box is opened, so nobody knows it while the cat can still eat. A cat weighed at or past its tolerance is sick: an ultra-rare trophy, never a death.

weight.rule: Once the box is opened, anyone weighs the cat: its weight is made public and sets its build, the highest whose minWeight it reaches. At the daily cap, chubby takes 10 days, fat 50, huge 150 and sick 300 to 600 days of feeding, so the builds stay rare for the life of the game. The build bonus, and the sick bonus on top, add to the rarity score.

burn.rule: Burnt cCROQ stays locked in the Pantry: no code path moves it. The encrypted running total is readable by nobody, so the circulating supply is unknown even though the total supply is public.

Shaken.note: The trait index is NOT emitted; it stays encrypted-side knowledge of the viewer.

DuelPosted.note: tokenIdB only means something when reserved.

DuelOpened.note: The holding was proven: the box is on the duel shelf.

DuelReopened.note: The accepter did not hold their box: back on the shelf.

DuelVoided.note: The challenger did not hold their box.

MealServed.note: Pantry. The amount is not emitted.

Purred.note: Pantry. The amount is not emitted.

Weighed.note: Pantry. The weight is public once the box is open.

Collected.note: Pantry. The amount is not emitted.
